noticeEn:
Update 1.0.8 is here!
- Faster first stage; clear Stage 20 to keep 2x speed free
- New Promotion Fusion: 4 cards of one rarity -> try for a higher-rarity mage
- Higher star bonuses

Also changed
- Relics now come from achievements or Mana Crystals (yours are kept)
- Tougher enemies from Stage 21 and Tower floor 31
See the mailbox for details.

109|2026-11-18|2026-12-16|-|-|유물·난이도 조정 안내|★ 유물
처음부터 주던 유물 8개는 업적 보상이 됐어요 (마나 결정으로 먼저 열 수도 있어요).
이미 가진 유물·강화는 모두 그대로예요.
결정 값(150~1,200)과 등급(일반~신화)·테두리 색을 다시 정했고, 9장 신화 유물 4종이 강해졌어요.
잠긴 유물을 누르면 얻는 방법이 나와요.
★ 난이도
21스테이지·탑 31층부터 적이 더 단단해졌어요. 깬 스테이지·별·보상은 그대로이고 소탕으로 계속 모을 수 있어요.
졌을 때 결과 화면의 '전투력을 올리려면'을 따라가 보세요.|Relic & difficulty update|- Relics
The 8 former starter relics are now achievement rewards (or unlock early with Mana Crystals).
Relics and upgrades you own are kept.
Prices (150~1,200), tiers (Common~Mythic) and frames were reorganized; the 4 Chapter 9 Mythic relics are stronger.
Tap a locked relic to see how to get it.
- Difficulty
Enemies are tougher from Stage 21 and Tower floor 31. Cleared stages, stars and rewards are kept; keep sweeping to farm.
After a loss, follow 'How to get stronger'.
